description: Issue #147, the negative: an issue whose declared files are a Markdown document and a JSON config derives NOTHING. Both paths ARE in suspected_files (the 成果物 heading makes the .md a deliverable, #50), so this is not "nothing was extracted" — it is the derivation declining to invent `docs/design/scope-derivation.test.md` or `config/app.test.json`, neither of which any repository has. The exclusion is the ABSENCE of a rule for those extensions rather than a deny-list, so a new non-source extension is silent by default; `app.json` is also not a dependency manifest, so the lockfile companions stay empty too and scope_defaults is empty as a whole.
